g.text: The five warehouse floors every number on this page was measured on
All drawn to one scale. Every aisle is one cell wide on all five; what differs is how long the aisles are, how many ways round there
are, and whether a robot standing still can cut the floor in two. Only `bottleneck` can -- its two halves meet in one corridor.
`corridors` is five 22-cell single-file runs joined at both ends; `narrow` is `medium` with the aisles twice as long and no extra way round.
